main.description: Hides a Colibri member's message after a moderator removed its copy on the other service. The community applies a hidden label to the message. Works only when an admin has turned on moderation mirroring for the registration.

community.description: The community the registration belongs to.

channel.description: The linked channel or thread the message lives in.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: RegistrationNotFound
errors.description: The community has no bridge registration with that id.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not the bridge this registration belongs to.

errors.name: RegistrationDisabled
errors.description: An admin has paused this registration.

errors.name: ChannelNotLinked
errors.description: The channel is not linked to this registration.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The bridge sent too many requests. Retry after the interval in the response headers.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

errors.name: ModerationMirrorOff
errors.description: Moderation mirroring is turned off for this registration.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No message exists at the given key in that channel.

errors.name: NotBridged
errors.description: The message was written by the community itself. Delete it with deleteMessage instead.
